summary: IONIS PHARMACEUTICALS INC filed an 8-K to disclose positive clinical trial results for zilganersen in Alexander disease. The filing is a routine current report under Items 7.01 (Regulation FD Disclosure) and 8.01 (Other Events) regarding a drug study meeting its primary endpoint and showing favorable safety. No special-situation event such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, restructuring, or management change is present. The filing is purely operational and regulatory disclosure.
